description: Self-hosted, browser-based SQL IDE for cloud-native teams, covering sixteen database engines with AI-assisted query writing and ER diagrams.
notes: The first run prints generated admin credentials to the terminal.
The server binds to the loopback interface only. Set LIBREDB_BIND=0.0.0.0 to expose it on the network.
Server-side state is kept under %LOCALAPPDATA%\LibreDB\Studio, outside the install directory, so it survives 'scoop update'.
